m0-context.title: Load baseline context
m0-context.imperative: Read docs/agents/CREW_CONTEXT.md, docs/agents/GLOSSARY.md, the g1 handoff, and relevant evo/latent-power context. Verify the handoff is complete: task, intent, allowed scope, exclusions, required evidence, test mode, and stop conditions. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: crew context, glossary, handoff, and relevant evo context loaded; handoff complete
postconditions.satisfied_by: Loaded CREW_CONTEXT, GLOSSARY, g1 handoff; scope limited to diagnostics producer + focused tests.

constraints: DB-only analysis; no direct FastF1 calls from analysis/model/adapter/predictor code.
Do not alter calibration objective, pairwise loss, model architecture, or training data selection.
Keep current stateless module/gold-cycle/sampled-runtime path as the single execution path.

m1-baseline.title: Run focused baseline tests
m1-baseline.imperative: Run/read the existing focused module uncertainty diagnostics tests before changing source or test code. If current code already satisfies g1, stop with evidence instead of churning.

postconditions.statement: existing focused tests ran before source/test changes

constraints: Do not modify files before this baseline evidence step completes.

m2-red.title: Add failing observability tests
m2-red.imperative: Add focused failing tests for compact, stable flags on empty usable event sets and fully skipped usable event sets in module uncertainty diagnostics JSON summary/module entries.

postconditions.statement: new g1 tests fail before implementation for missing diagnostic flags

constraints: Flags must be compact, stable strings.
No model training, calibration math, or recursive behavior changes.

status_detail.reason: TDD red step intentionally exits nonzero; red failure evidence attached, proceed to implementation per Pilot steering.

payload.outcome: expected red failure after tests-only edit

m3-green.title: Implement minimal report flags
m3-green.imperative: Implement the minimal module uncertainty diagnostic/report code to pass the new tests while preserving training and calibration math.

preconditions.statement: red tests observed for missing flags
preconditions.satisfied_by: m2 red evidence attached; 3 expected failures for missing flags/counters

postconditions.statement: module uncertainty diagnostics expose empty and fully skipped usable event flags; focused tests pass

constraints: Do not alter calibration objective, pairwise loss, model architecture, or training data selection.
Scope limited to module_uncertainty_diagnostics.py and its focused tests.

m4-final.title: Final scope and evidence pass
m4-final.imperative: Inspect the final diff for gate scope, confirm no forbidden training/calibration/model objective changes, and record final focused test evidence.

postconditions.statement: final focused tests pass after scope review

constraints: Do not archive Commander/Pilot work area.
